description: B0 candidate 3: per-frame 2D CA-CFAR on |2dfft|^2 (integral-image), 3x3 local-max suppression, MTI static-clutter exclusion (doppler +/-1 around DC), region range filter, count hysteresis. Seated-person energy sits at doppler DC and is intentionally filtered -- this reproduces the official-baseline weak static detection and is direct RQ2 evidence; B0 v1 is a region moving-target detector, M1 owns static occupancy.
target_count_policy: in-region point count after MTI (per frame), -1 when unknown/invalid
